title: Essential role of Rnd1 in innate immunity during viral and bacterial infections
authors: Akhilesh Kumar; Shalabh Mishra; Ashish Kumar; Ashwin Ashok Raut; Seiichi Sato; Akinori Takaoka; Hima...
abstract: Rnd1, a constitutively active Rho GTPase, was identified as a key player in innate immunity. It protects against viral and bacterial infections through distinct interferon-independent mechanisms.

title: Rho GTPase Expression in Human Myeloid Cells
authors: Suzanne F. G. van Helden; Eloise C. Anthony; Rob Dee; Peter L. Hordijk
abstract: This study investigated Rho GTPase expression in human myeloid cells using qPCR. The most abundant Rho GTPases were Cdc42, RhoQ, Rac1, Rac2, RhoA, and RhoC, with expression profiles varying by cell type and differentiation state.

authors: Laetitia Mouly; Julia Gilhodes; Anthony Lemarié; Elizabeth Cohen-Jonathan Moyal; Christine Toulas; G...
id: Matched: RND1, an Atypical Rho GTPase
abstract: This paper reviews the functions of the atypical Rho GTPase RND1 in healthy tissues and its emerging role in oncogenesis. RND1 acts as a tumor suppressor, with low expression correlating to poor prognosis and treatment response.

title: Deletion of Rac1GTPase in the Myeloid Lineage Protects against Inflammation-Mediated Kidney Injury in Mice
authors: Miki Nagase; Hidetake Kurihara; Atsu Aiba; Morag J. Young; Tatsuo Sakai
id: Matched: Involvement of macrophage Rac1 signaling in LPS-evoked cytokine produc
abstract: Myeloid-specific deletion of Rac1 was studied in a mouse model of kidney injury. This deletion protected against inflammation-mediated kidney damage by suppressing inflammatory cytokine production.

title: A New Member of the Rho Family, Rnd1, Promotes Disassembly of Actin Filament Structures and Loss of Cell Adhesion
authors: Catherine D. Nobes; Inger Lauritzen; Marie-Geneviève Mattei; Sonia Paris; Alan Hall; Pierre Chardin
abstract: Rnd1, a new Rho family member, was studied for its effects on actin and cell adhesion. Rnd1 expression inhibits actin structures and causes cell rounding by promoting loss of adhesion.

abstract: RvD1 was administered to mice to study its effect on inflammation resolution. RvD1 promotes macrophage apoptosis via the ALX/FasL-FasR/caspase-3 pathway, accelerating inflammation resolution and potentially treating ARDS.

title: Macrophage Migration and Its Regulation by CSF-1
authors: Fiona J. Pixley
id: Matched: 6. Rho Family GTPases in Macrophage Motility
abstract: This study investigated macrophage migration and its regulation by CSF-1. Macrophage motility is primarily controlled by CSF-1 signaling through the Y721 residue on its receptor, which activates PI3K.

authors: Diletta Ami; Ana Rita Franco; Valentina Artusa; Paolo Mereghetti; Francesco Peri; Antonino Natalello
abstract: Fourier transform infrared microspectroscopy analyzed THP-1 derived macrophages treated with LPS. The study identified spectral markers in lipids, proteins, and sulfated sugars, highlighting their role in inflammation.

authors: Brener C. Carvalho; Leonardo C. Oliveira; Carolina D. Rocha; Heliana B. Fernandes; Isadora M. Olivei...
abstract: This paper presents data on molecular tools for studying Rap2a GTPase in LPS-induced immune responses. The data support Rap2a's role in macrophage activation and NF-κB signaling.

authors: Nathalie Thiéblemont; Samuel D. Wright

abstract: This study analyzed the transcriptional response of sheep macrophages to lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and compared it to other mammalian species. A conserved transcriptional network was found, but large animals and rodents differed in their metabolic responses to LPS.

authors: Changyuan Fan; Xinyi Huang; Jie Mei; Xuemeng Shi; Hao Zhang; Cong Liang; Shuzhi Cui; Yifan Xing; Bia...

abstract: Macrophages form dendrite-like pseudopods to increase their surface area and search radius. This morphological adaptation enhances bacterial ingestion and bolsters host defense against severe Gram-negative infections.

authors: Monica Madalina Tucureanu; Daniela Rebleanu; Cristina Ana Constantinescu; Mariana Deleanu; Geanina V...
abstract: Liposomes encapsulating a G$_i$-protein inhibitor were tested for anti-inflammatory effects in LPS-activated monocytes/macrophages. Liposomal delivery of the inhibitor effectively blocked LPS-induced inflammation, cytokine production, monocyte adhesion, and chemotaxis.

abstract: This study mathematically models macrophage responses to LPS, analyzing single-cell protein expression. Macrophage hypo-responsiveness to secondary LPS challenges is driven by altered transition rates to non-responsive states.

authors: Qian Sun; Yang Xu; Fan’en Yuan; Yangzhi Qi; Yixuan Wang; Qianxue Chen; Baohui Liu

abstract: This study investigated Rho family GTPase 1 (RND1) as a regulator of p53 and ferroptosis in glioblastoma. RND1 enhances ferroptosis in glioblastoma by stabilizing p53 and activating the p53-SLC7A11 pathway.

authors: Pablo Veloso; Alejandra Fernández; Jessica Astorga; David González-Quintanilla; Alfredo Castro; Alej...
abstract: This study investigated the effects of lipopolysaccharides from *Porphyromonas gingivalis* and *Porphyromonas endodontalis* on macrophage polarization. *P. gingivalis* LPS induced an M1 macrophage profile, while *P. endodontalis* LPS did not.

abstract: This study investigated miR-144-5p's role in LPS-induced macrophages. miR-144-5p overexpression reduced cell viability and inflammatory cytokine expression by targeting TLR2 and inhibiting NF-κB signaling.

authors: Axel Berg-Larsen; Ole J. B. Landsverk; Cinzia Progida; Tone F. Gregers; Oddmund Bakke
abstract: Lipopolysaccharide activation alters Rab GTPase expression in monocyte-derived dendritic cells. This differential regulation correlates with changes in cellular functions observed during dendritic cell maturation.

abstract: RND3 expression is induced in activated macrophages and potentiates NOTCH signaling. This leads to increased proinflammatory gene expression, suggesting RND3 fine-tunes macrophage inflammatory responses.
